A dental clinic in the Khlong Ton Sai area, near the pedestrian overpass. They offer various dental services including fillings, braces, scaling, fluoride treatments, and root canal treatment. Locals in the area frequent this clinic for good service at affordable prices. Examinations and consultations are provided by licensed dentists. Insured patients do not need to pay upfront. Parking is available for self-collection.

The website stated opening time was 9 am. Upon arrival, the staff informed me that the doctor would arrive at 10 am, slightly late. They prioritized patients with scheduled appointments, meaning I waited over an hour. When I asked how much longer it would be to see the doctor, the staff replied that they would prioritize those with appointments and asked if I had any other errands to run.

The staff was polite and courteous, but this question should have been asked and stated when I signed in. That way, I could have considered whether to wait or go to another clinic, instead of being told to sit and wait or having to ask myself. In short, I didn't get treated; it was a waste of time.

There are many clinics in this area, but I didn't go there. I ended up waiting for over an hour, almost two hours. The dentist was clean and kind, but the staff didn't inform me that appointments were required beforehand. I wasted a lot of time waiting. If you have the chance, it's better to ask about appointment times beforehand. Otherwise, go somewhere else. It's a waste of time waiting.
